title: Shared definitions
$comment: Shared $defs for the contract schemas. URL and UTC date-time rules are patterns on purpose: the JSON Schema uri format and Zod's built-in URL validator disagree on spaces and empty hosts, so both validators use the same regex. Cross-document integrity (referenced ids exist, prerequisite graph is acyclic) is checked by the Phase 2 and Phase 5 validators, not by JSON Schema.
